description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
  
  
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
  
  
Expedia Group powers global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting-edge technology to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential to driving our success. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.
  
  
**About The Team – EG Clickstream**
EG Clickstream provides data that captures user behavior and experience across Expedia Group sites and apps. This data forms the building blocks for understanding user journeys: what products users search for, which features they see and use, and which marketing channels they arrive from. It powers analysis of Product and Marketing performance to support optimized decision-making and can also be used programmatically to drive personalized, adaptive experiences for our users.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Software Development Engineer II on Expedia Group’s Clickstream team, you will design, build, and operate the real-time data platform that captures and processes user behavior across our sites and apps. You will engineer scalable, resilient streaming systems that power analytics, marketing, and personalized experiences globally. You bring strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, deep proficiency in coding and distributed systems design, and a passion for solving complex problems of scale. You are collaborative, creative, and thrive in a dynamic, agile environment where you continuously learn and raise the bar.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Design, build, and operate highly available, low-latency streaming services and data pipelines (primarily in Java/Kotlin) running in public/hybrid cloud environments.
* Write clean, efficient, well-tested code; practice pair programming and conduct thorough code reviews.
* Apply object-oriented design, distributed computing, performance/scalability tuning, and advanced data structures/algorithms to real-time streaming and data processing.
* Build and evolve microservices and data APIs that power analytics and personalized experiences.
* Implement robust testing, monitoring, alerting, and observability to ensure reliability and rapid incident response.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and drive long-term fixes and improvements.
* Collaborate with product managers, data engineers, analysts, and platform teams to deliver high-impact solutions.
* Contribute to technical design documents; communicate trade-offs and decisions clearly within the team.
* Stay current with advancements in cloud data platforms, streaming technologies, and best practices; mentor junior engineers.

Who you are
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 2+ years of professional software development experience, including building and operating backend/microservices in Java; Kotlin or Scala experience is a plus.
* Hands-on experience with streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub) and event-driven architectures.
* Experience building production-grade data processing applications in public/hybrid cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
* Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals: algorithms, data structures, concurrency, distributed systems, and design patterns.
* Proficiency in testing strategies (unit, integration), CI/CD, monitoring, alerting, and incident management.
* Familiarity with observability concepts and tools to monitor application health and performance.
* Strong debugging, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills; self-starter with a learning mindset.
* Familiarity with basic AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, code assistants) to accelerate development or documentation, used responsibly within company policies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Kafka Streams (KStream) and/or Apache Flink for stateful stream processing.
* Familiarity with schema registry, data lake technologies, and data quality frameworks

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

title: Principal Mobile Engineer
description:
**About Payoneer**
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
  
  
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
  
  
**Principal Mobile Engineer**
AI-Native Cloud Platform
  
  
**Team:**
Mobile Platform Team
  
  
**Reports to:**
Sr. Director of R&D, Cloud Platform
  
  
**Location:**
[Gurgaon / Hybrid]
  
  
**About The Role**
Payoneer is investing in the next generation of its mobile application: lightweight, high-performance, and designed as a platform that lets product teams contribute features independently while the app remains coherent, fast, and stable as a whole. The host application will provide the common foundations — observability, logging, navigation, identity, networking, feature flags, release tooling, automation — and product teams will plug into it through a clear contribution model.
  
  
We are hiring two Principal Mobile Engineers to define and build this foundation alongside the existing mobile team. Together you will own the tech stack decision — native iOS and Android, Flutter, React Native or a hybrid — and you will shape the platform every product team at Payoneer ships mobile features on top of. The two-Principal structure gives us the capacity to build the platform properly, and the optionality to specialize one Principal per native platform if we go that route.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**
You will own the tech stack decision and the rationale behind it. You will run the evaluation — native (Swift / Kotlin) vs Flutter vs React Native vs hybrid — against real constraints: performance, binary size, hiring market, team contribution model, build and release velocity, long-term maintenance cost. You will make the call jointly with your peer Principal and you will be expected to defend it under scrutiny from engineering, product, and executive leadership.
  
  
You will build the host application foundation. The architecture, the module boundaries, the navigation and lifecycle model, the dependency injection approach, the state management patterns, the threading and concurrency model, the network stack, the persistence layer, the observability and logging backbone, the release and rollout machinery, the testing strategy at every level of the pyramid. Every product team’s first impression of mobile at Payoneer will be the abstractions you ship.
  
  
You will define the contribution model that product teams use to deliver features into the host app. Module boundaries, public API surface, lifecycle hooks, dependency policy, build and integration patterns, version compatibility, and the developer experience that makes contributing a feature fast and contributing a bad one hard. You will own the standards every contributing team writes against.
  
  
You will own performance, binary size, startup time, frame rate, memory, and battery as first-class engineering disciplines with measured budgets and gates. You will own crash-free rate and stability as platform commitments. You will own the CI/CD, signing, release, and rollout pipeline for the app, and the observability that makes a production issue debuggable in minutes rather than days.
  
  
You will partner with the Application Foundations Crew and the Cloud Platform Base, DevEx, and Network and Security teams to make sure mobile integrates cleanly with the platform — APIs, events, identity, secrets, automation and the shift-left controls that apply on the mobile side as much as the server side. You will partner with product engineering across the company to bring contributing teams into the platform and keep them productive in it.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**
You have ten or more years of mobile engineering experience and you have built mobile applications from the ground up — not joined them, not iterated on them, but defined the foundation and shipped it to production at scale. You have an honest, scarred view of what mobile platform decisions cost three years after you make them.
  
  
You are deeply expert in at least one of iOS or Android, and seriously fluent in the other. On iOS that means Swift, the Swift concurrency model, UIKit and SwiftUI, the Apple toolchain and release process, and the parts of the ecosystem most engineers learn the hard way. On Android that means Kotlin, coroutines and Flow, the Android lifecycle, Jetpack and Compose, Gradle in earnest, RxJava where it still lives, and the same hard-won understanding of the ecosystem.
  
  
You understand the cross-platform landscape with the same honesty. You have an opinion on Flutter, KMP, and React Native that goes beyond preference — performance characteristics, ceiling, where each shines, where each fails — and you can defend the recommendation you would make for a fintech app at Payoneer’s scale.
  
  
You have built and operated a modular mobile platform before, or something close enough that you understand the trade-offs: how to define module boundaries that survive ten product teams contributing in parallel, how to keep the host app coherent when contributors disagree, how to version a contribution model without breaking everyone, and how to keep the binary lean as the surface grows.
  
  
You think in budgets and measurements. You have driven startup time, frame rate, binary size, and crash-free rate as numbers on a dashboard. You understand mobile observability at a level beyond crash reporting, and you have shipped the instrumentation needed to debug productio.
  
  
You communicate clearly with engineers, product partners, and executives. You can write a one-page architecture proposal, run an RFC that actually converges, demo what you built so other engineers want to use it, and explain a stack decision to a CPO in language they care about. You handle disagreement well — including with your peer Principal — and you know how to land a joint decision.
  
  
**Nice to have**
Experience integrating AI capabilities into mobile applications — on-device models, conversational and agent UI patterns, latency-sensitive AI features, and the privacy and offline considerations that come with them — is a strong plus, given Payoneer’s AI-native platform direction.
  
  
**Why this role matters**
The mobile app is the surface Payoneer customers touch after Web. The foundation you build will compound for years. You will have unusual scope to define what good looks like for Payoneer, and credibly for the industry, at the point where regulated payments, mobile engineering at scale, and AI-native development converge.
  
  
**The Payoneer Ways of Working**
**Act as our customer’s partner on the inside**
*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*
**Do it. Own it.**
*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*
**Continuously improve**
*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*
**Build Each Other Up**
*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*
If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.*

title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
About Team
  
  
GDF sits at the core of Walmart's AI & Data organization, building the foundational data platforms that make it possible for every team at Walmart — technical or non-technical — to build with trustworthy, well-governed, discoverable data. Our platforms serve billions of transactions and interactions across 19 countries, powering everything from supply chain intelligence to customer-facing personalization to enterprise AI agents. This particular team is newly formed to solve one of GDF's next big platform bets — which means you'll be shaping charter, operating model, and delivery cadence essentially from a blank page, not inheriting someone else's playbook.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Lead the engineering team(s) responsible for designing, building, and operating GDF's core data platform capabilities - pipelines, processing frameworks, storage layers, and service APIs that power downstream analytics and AI workloads across Walmart.
  
  
Stay hands-on: write and review production code, prototype solutions to hard technical problems, and participate directly in design and code reviews rather than delegating all technical depth to the team.
  
  
Own the engineering roadmap, technical execution, and delivery of scalable, high-throughput data services built on languages/frameworks including Java, Python, and Spark.
  
  
Guide architecture and system design decisions across distributed data processing systems, batch and streaming pipelines, data lake/lakehouse storage, and enterprise integrations.
  
  
Drive the design and evolution of Big Data capabilities - data ingestion, transformation, quality, observability, and governance - at the scale Walmart's platforms require.
  
  
Partner with product managers, data scientists, ML engineers, and platform/security teams to deliver reliable, well-governed data capabilities that enable downstream analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases.
  
  
Lead pragmatic integration of AI and GenAI capabilities into the data platform - e.g., feature pipelines for ML models, embeddings/vector search for retrieval, LLM-assisted data quality checks, and intelligent pipeline monitoring - wherever they create measurable engineering or business value.
  
  
Ensure systems are designed for scalability, reliability, performance, observability, security, and cost efficiency, appropriate for petabyte-scale enterprise data platforms.
  
  
Lead engineering execution across the full software development lifecycle - design, coding, testing, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, incident management, and ongoing operational excellence.
  
  
Champion DevOps, platform engineering, and automation best practices to improve engineering velocity, reduce toil, and support continuous delivery for a newly formed team building process and standards from scratch.
  
  
Establish engineering standards through architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, testing strategy, observability practices, and production readiness reviews.
  
  
Define and track engineering and data quality metrics - availability, latency, pipeline SLAs, data freshness, defect rates, deployment frequency, incident trends, and cost efficiency.
  
  
Hire, mentor, and develop hands-on engineers, building a high-performing team culture grounded in craftsmanship, ownership, and continuous learning.
  
  
Build strong cross-functional relationships across engineering, product, data science, and business teams to align priorities, manage dependencies, and remove blockers.

By fostering collaboration across all World Bank Group entities—including IBRD, IDA, IFC, MIGA, and ICSID—ITSTO leverages technology as a catalyst for accelerating development impact and advancing digital transformation. **Unit Context**
The Infrastructure Engineering team is instrumental in advancing the World Bank Group’s mission by designing, building, and maintaining the foundational IT infrastructure that supports global operations. The team manages critical infrastructure components end-to-end, including data centers, infrastructure as code, enterprise networks, storage systems, compute resources, virtualization platforms, and disaster recovery solutions. Their efforts ensure that infrastructure services are robust, secure, scalable, and cost-effective, forming the backbone for reliable digital services across all business units.
  
  
Committed to operational excellence and continuous improvement, Infrastructure Engineering proactively monitors and optimizes infrastructure performance to meet evolving business needs. The team leads modernization initiatives, adopts emerging technologies, and implements best practices in infrastructure management. Collaboration with other technology teams—including cloud engineering, cybersecurity, application development, and IT service management—ensures seamless integration of cloud, automation, and security strategies.
  
  
Supporting the World Bank Group’s digital transformation agenda, Infrastructure Engineering champions innovative solutions and automation to enhance the productivity and efficiency of IT operations. The team also plays a vital role in ensuring business continuity and resilience through comprehensive disaster recovery planning and execution. By fostering a culture of collaboration, agility, and technical excellence, Infrastructure Engineering empowers the organization to deliver reliable, high-performing digital services that enable global development operations and advance the Bank’s strategic objectives.
  
  
**Duties And Accountabilities**
The DevOps/DDI Engineer is responsible for maintaining the enterprise DDI (DNS, DHCP and IPAM) infrastructure and developing automation scripts and tools to improve the network reliability and visibility.
  
  
For this role, the ideal candidate is a technology leader with strong interpersonal skills, capable of energizing and influencing others, fostering collaboration, building consensus, and proactively addressing challenges to achieve key deliverables.
  
  
The role requires a hands-on approach in a multicultural environment which supports diversity, continuous learning, enhancing skillsets and collaboration. The ideal candidate must demonstrate excellent communication skills as the position requires frequent interaction with multiple cross-functional teams. The candidate must possess a strong sense of curiosity, adaptability, and the drive to learn and innovate.
  
  
We provide a meaningful, open, and collaborative environment. We have many interesting problems to solve, providing you an opportunity to develop your skills while contributing to the mission of the bank. We value teamwork, openness, curiosity, and persistence.

* Automate the environment using various scripts and tools like Python, Perl, Ansible and Terraform.
* Enhance the team’s proactive monitoring capability by creating automated reports/alerts for network events.

title: Sr. Post Silicon Validation Engineer
description:
Job Title: Post-Silicon Validation Engineer

---

Job Summary:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically strong Post-Silicon Validation Engineer to join our hardware engineering team. This role involves validating and debugging complex SoCs or mixed-signal ICs after silicon manufacturing. You will work closely with design, verification, DFT, and test teams to ensure product performance, functionality, and compliance with specifications through lab-based testing and analysis.

---

Roles & Responsibilities:

· Develop and execute post-silicon validation plans for analog, digital, and mixed-signal IPs and SoCs.

· Design and automate test setups for functionality, performance, and stress testing.

· Use lab equipment (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, etc.) for signal integrity, timing, and power measurements.

· Debug silicon issues by analyzing waveforms, logs, and failure patterns, and provide root cause analysis.

· Collaborate with design and verification teams to drive bug resolution and silicon fixes (ECOs).

· Write Python/MATLAB/LabVIEW-based automation scripts to improve validation efficiency.

· Document test cases, procedures, results, and validation reports for internal and customer use.

· Perform silicon characterization across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) corners.

· Support bring-up and system integration activities involving FPGA platforms or evaluation boards.

· Participate in customer debug and yield improvement efforts when required.

· Support pre-tapeout activities such as validation readiness reviews, DFT strategy, and board planning.

---

Education and Experience Required:

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics/Electrical Engineering, or equivalent.

· 2–6 years of hands-on experience in post-silicon validation, RF testing, or mixed-signal test development.

· Prior exposure to ASIC/SoC design validation, board bring-up, or silicon characterization is highly desirable.

---

Competencies Description:

· Strong understanding of digital/analog/mixed-signal circuit behavior.

· Proficient in using lab equipment (e.g., oscilloscopes, VNAs, AWGs, signal generators, spectrum analyzers).

· Proficient in scripting languages such as Python, MATLAB, TCL, or C for lab automation.

· Familiarity with communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, PCIe, MIPI, etc.).

· Knowledge of RTL design (Verilog/VHDL) and FPGA prototyping/debug is a plus.

· Analytical and structured problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

· Good communication skills and ability to work in cross-functional, multi-site teams.

---

Must-Have Skills:

· Solid understanding of analog/mixed-signal IPs: RFIC, ADC, DAC, PLL, Oscillators, Voltage Regulators, Temperature Sensors.

· Post-silicon validation and debugging experience on real silicon or evaluation boards.

· Experience with PVT testing, statistical analysis, and corner case validation.

· Proficiency in lab instruments: Oscilloscope, Logic Analyzer, Spectrum Analyzer, Network Analyzer, Signal Generator, Power Supply, DMM.

· Strong automation skills using Python, MATLAB, or equivalent.

· Solid knowledge of SoC/ASIC architecture, clocks, resets, and power domains.

· Hands-on experience with bench-level testing, PCB schematics, and soldering/debugging.

· Exposure to signal processing, RF, or high-speed serial interfaces is a strong advantage.

· Good grasp of semiconductor fundamentals, signal integrity, power analysis, and board-level validation

title: Technical Projects Systems Engineer
description:
Position Description: Customer Proof of Concepts Engineer
  
  
Organization Overview
  
  
Global Demonstration Engineering leads the industry in delivering innovative, demonstration-centric experiences of Cisco solutions to customers. We provide a comprehensive, integrated sales-enablement portfolio that helps sales teams and partners showcase how Cisco products enhance productivity, expand sales opportunities, and shorten sales cycles. Our Cisco dCloud platform offers scripted, repeatable demos and fully customizable labs with complete administrative access, accessible on any network, device, and location. The dCloud platform not only improves user experiences but also drives business growth.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Proof-of-Concept (POC) Specialist is a Systems Engineer (SE) responsible for the end-to-end development, planning, design, delivery, and coordination of Customer Proof of Concept Labs, primarily focused on Enterprise Networking and Nexus (NX) technologies, but may include other Cisco technologies. This role involves close collaboration with Business Units (BUs), Content Developers, Partners (internal and third-party), and account teams throughout the POC lifecycle—from introduction through build, testing, and final customer delivery. The specialist will gather customer requirements, define testing criteria, and ensure POC objectives are met.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Project Management (10%)
  
  

* Identify, prioritize, and organize all project-related tasks.
* Strategize and communicate project goals and objectives across organizational levels.
* Ensure effective status reporting from all third-party developers involved in assigned projects.

Engineering (50%)
  
  

* Design, develop, document, and deliver diverse POC content, mainly for Enterprise Networks and NX.
* Collaborate with Account Teams, Technical Marketing Engineers (TMEs), Content Developers, Partners, and customers to extract requirements.
* Create design and test plans aligned with POC objectives.
* Lead the POC engineering efforts from introduction through build, test, and delivery phases.
* Work collaboratively with a multidisciplinary engineering team.

Platform Design (20%)
  
  

* Document and plan all projects thoroughly before the build phase.
* Utilize standard design tools and templates such as Visio, PowerPoint, and MS Project.
* Present and justify designs to peer review groups.

Support (10%)
  
  

* Serve as the first point of contact for all escalations related to POCs.
* Collaborate with account teams, partners, and customers to ensure successful POC delivery.
* Manage escalations by coordinating with responsible engineers to provide fixes, document solutions, update the Support Knowledge Base, and train Tier 1 and Tier 2 engineers.
* Work with project managers to ensure content and documentation updates are planned and executed.
* Liaise with operations teams to resolve issues during development and testing, provide technical support, and recommend design improvements.

Other Duties (5%)
  
  

* Act as a liaison with third-party developers and independently develop content as needed.

Candidate Requirements
  
  

* CCNP/CCIE certification or equivalent experience.
* Strong background in Routing, Switching, and Security protocols, including OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, MPLS, DMVPN, IPSec, NAT, Trustsec, LISP, VXLAN, EVPN, and 802.1x.
* Experience with Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN, including controller deployment (on-premise and cloud), template and policy management, and Cloud On-Ramp for Multi-Cloud.
* Expertise in Cisco Software Defined Access (SDA), including Cisco Catalyst Center (DNA Center) deployment and management, network device provisioning, SWIM, templates, Plug-and-Play, and SD-Access Fabric.
* Cloud networking experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, and Microsoft Office365.
* Familiarity with virtual infrastructures such as VMware vCenter and virtual machines.
* Experience with test tools like Spirent, Cyberflood, Avalanche, Ixia, Keysight, and WAN emulation.
* Knowledge of Cisco security products is a plus, including SSE, Meraki, Secure Access, Secure Cloud Control, NGFW, ISE, Stealthwatch, ThousandEyes, Umbrella, Threat Defense, Defense Orchestrator, Cyber Vision, and Office 365.
* Proven project delivery, project management, and time management skills.

**Additional Desired Skills**

* Basic programming and scripting skills in Go, Python, Ruby, PowerShell, XML, SQL, etc.
* Basic web development and scripting knowledge.

**Qualifications And Competencies**

* Strong self-management and time management skills with the ability to organize competing priorities across global time zones.
* Sense of urgency and adaptability to shifting team demands and critical time-to-market business needs.
* Flexibility to handle a wide range of tasks and rapidly switch between projects in a fast-paced environment.
* Analytical skills to use source materials effectively, think critically, identify risks, and recommend actions.
* Attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and adherence to standards.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and oral, with an emphasis on building relationships and promoting collaborative goals.
* Professionalism in managing people, problems, stress, and persistence to complete tasks.
* Dependability and reliability in meeting commitments and producing high-quality work.
* Independent learning ability with creative problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to information gathering.
* Strong planning and organizational skills to anticipate problems, manage complexity, and meet deadlines.

Reporting Structure
  
  

* Reports to: SE Operations Manager
* Works Closely With: Content Development Team, Project Management Team, Practice Leads, Automation/UI Development Team, Technical Writing Team, dCloud Social Media Specialist, Platform Team, and NetOps Team
* Direct Reports: None

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**I&O Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst**
**The opportunity**
In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for a skilled Infrastructure Data Analyst to support and evolve EY's I&O data analytics and reporting capabilities globally. This is a unique role that bridges deep data analysis with practical infrastructure knowledge, enabling the firm to transform operational data from across its data center, compute, network, storage and observability platforms into actionable intelligence.
  
  
A key focus of this role is providing the analytical intelligence layer for the Hyperconverged Service Platform (HCSP) — EY's next-generation infrastructure automation platform built on Kubernetes, Temporal and Terraform. The Data Analyst will own the measurement, reporting and continuous improvement analysis of HCSP's provisioning performance, workflow reliability, SLA attainment, drift detection efficacy and operational impact across EY's global data center estate — directly enabling the platform team to measure success, identify failure patterns and demonstrate value.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
The I&O Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst collects, processes and analyzes operational data from across EY's infrastructure platforms — with a particular focus on HCSP platform telemetry — transforming raw data from workflow orchestration systems, provisioning engines, log aggregation platforms, ITSM tools and capacity management systems into meaningful insights and visualizations.
  
  
The role requires a strong analytical skill set combined with sufficient infrastructure and platform automation awareness to understand the context of the data being analyzed. The analyst will serve as the analytical authority for HCSP KPI reporting — tracking metrics such as provisioning SLA attainment, orchestrator failure rates, manual touchpoint reduction, rollback success rates and catalog drift elimination — and will partner with the HCSP engineering team, I&O leadership and service management to drive a data-informed culture of continuous platform improvement.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong experience designing and delivering data analytics solutions using Power BI, including complex DAX measures, data models and report publishing.
* Proficiency querying and analyzing data from ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) including KQL query development and Kibana dashboard creation.
* Experience working with large, multi-source operational datasets and transforming them into executive and operational reporting.
* Ability to analyze and report on platform automation data, including:

+ Workflow execution metrics
+ OPA policy evaluation outcomes and policy compliance trends
+ Drift detection signals
+ ServiceNow order intake volumes, ticket correlation

* Good understanding of data center infrastructure technologies including:

+ Windows Server and Linux operating system fundamentals
+ Virtualization platforms — Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware
+ Kubernetes cluster concepts — pods, namespaces, workloads and resource utilization
+ Network fundamentals — VLANs, DNS, IP management
+ Storage and compute provisioning concepts

* Experience with SQL or KQL for querying structured and semi-structured data sources.
* Experience integrating data from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow or equivalent) into analytical reporting.
* Familiarity with APM and monitoring tooling (Dynatrace, SolarWinds, Prometheus or equivalent) as data sources.
* Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion from multiple infrastructure and platform data sources.
* Scripting capability to automate data extraction and transformation tasks:

+ Python (pandas, NumPy, requests)
+ PowerShell
+ Bash

* Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to present HCSP performance findings and SLA trend analysis to both technical and senior business audiences.
* Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.
* Ability to work effectively with global engineering and service management teams across multiple time zones.

**To qualify for the role, you must have experience with**

* Power BI report and dashboard development — 5–7 years.
* Power BI data modelling, DAX development and Power Query (M) transformations — 5–7 years.
* ELK stack data analysis — Elasticsearch queries and Kibana dashboard development — 3–5 years.
* SQL data analysis and querying against operational data stores — 5–7 years.
* KPI definition, metric design and SLA/OLA reporting for platform or infrastructure services.
* Data integration from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Remedy or equivalent).
* Working with infrastructure and platform automation monitoring data — metrics, logs, workflow events and traces.
* Building capacity planning and trend analysis reports for infrastructure and automation platforms.
* Kubernetes and container platform telemetry consumption and analysis.
* Workflow orchestration data analysis — Temporal, Argo or equivalent execution logs and metrics.
* OPA policy evaluation data analysis and compliance reporting.
* Drift detection and configuration audit data analysis.
* Windows Server and Linux operating system concepts — sufficient to contextualize infrastructure data.
* Virtualization platform familiarity (Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware vSphere or Azure Stack HCI).
* Python scripting for data extraction, transformation and automation — 3–5 years.
* PowerShell scripting for Windows infrastructure data collection.
* Executive reporting and stakeholder presentation delivery.
* Azure Monitor, Log Analytics or equivalent cloud observability data sources (preferred).
* Working with CMDB data to enrich infrastructure and platform analytics (preferred).

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification (desired).
* Elastic Certified Analyst certification (desired).
* Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900) or Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) (better to have).
* ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary).
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics or Databricks (better to have).
* Experience with Grafana or similar open-source visualization platforms.
* Familiarity with OpenTelemetry (OTel) as a telemetry standard for HCSP platform automation data.
* Experience analyzing data from Temporal.io workflow execution APIs or audit logs.
* Experience with Terraform state data and infrastructure drift analysis.
* Experience operating within a managed services or large enterprise shared services environment.

**What We Look For**
A data-driven professional with a genuine curiosity for infrastructure platform operations and a talent for turning complex, multi-source operational data into clear and actionable insight. We are looking for an individual who combines strong analytical and visualization skills with practical infrastructure and platform automation awareness — enabling them to serve as the trusted analytical partner to EY's HCSP engineering team and I&O leadership, measuring the platform's impact, identifying improvement opportunities and demonstrating the value of automation at scale.
  
  
**What We Offer**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you'll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

title: Quality Assurance Engineering Specialist
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Consulting Services, a part of GE Vernova, has offices in multiple countries and offers our global clients (external & internal GE) a wide range of solutions across the entire spectrum of power generation, delivery, and utilization. Our Power Systems Engineering team utilizes their deep knowledge of connected power grid planning, design, operation, and life-cycle management, to offer customized solutions to our global clients. Our Power Economics team offers analyses focused on the understanding and the study of the financial and physical operation of the electric power systems including generation and grid planning, system optimization, asset valuation, competitive power markets and energy policy implications. Our software business plays a critical role in delivering these solutions by developing and maintaining cutting-edge analytics platforms for production cost modeling, capacity expansion, reliability assessment, market simulation and both steady-state and transient stability simulation. These tools are continuously enhanced based on feedback from consulting engagements and evolving industry needs. Over 700 entities worldwide use our suite of software tools to assess the economics, performance, and reliability of interconnected power systems. We also offer a full range of education courses through our Power Systems Engineering Course.

title: Validation Engineer
description:
Job Title: Post-Silicon Validation Engineer

---

Job Summary:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically strong Post-Silicon Validation Engineer to join our hardware engineering team. This role involves validating and debugging complex SoCs or mixed-signal ICs after silicon manufacturing. You will work closely with design, verification, DFT, and test teams to ensure product performance, functionality, and compliance with specifications through lab-based testing and analysis.

---

Roles & Responsibilities:

· Develop and execute post-silicon validation plans for analog, digital, and mixed-signal IPs and SoCs.

· Design and automate test setups for functionality, performance, and stress testing.

· Use lab equipment (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, etc.) for signal integrity, timing, and power measurements.

· Debug silicon issues by analyzing waveforms, logs, and failure patterns, and provide root cause analysis.

· Collaborate with design and verification teams to drive bug resolution and silicon fixes (ECOs).

· Write Python/MATLAB/LabVIEW-based automation scripts to improve validation efficiency.

· Document test cases, procedures, results, and validation reports for internal and customer use.

· Perform silicon characterization across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) corners.

· Support bring-up and system integration activities involving FPGA platforms or evaluation boards.

· Participate in customer debug and yield improvement efforts when required.

· Support pre-tapeout activities such as validation readiness reviews, DFT strategy, and board planning.

---

Education and Experience Required:

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics/Electrical Engineering, or equivalent.

· 2–6 years of hands-on experience in post-silicon validation, RF testing, or mixed-signal test development.

· Prior exposure to ASIC/SoC design validation, board bring-up, or silicon characterization is highly desirable.

---

Competencies Description:

· Strong understanding of digital/analog/mixed-signal circuit behavior.

· Proficient in using lab equipment (e.g., oscilloscopes, VNAs, AWGs, signal generators, spectrum analyzers).

· Proficient in scripting languages such as Python, MATLAB, TCL, or C for lab automation.

· Familiarity with communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, PCIe, MIPI, etc.).

· Knowledge of RTL design (Verilog/VHDL) and FPGA prototyping/debug is a plus.

· Analytical and structured problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

· Good communication skills and ability to work in cross-functional, multi-site teams.

---

Must-Have Skills:

· Solid understanding of analog/mixed-signal IPs: RFIC, ADC, DAC, PLL, Oscillators, Voltage Regulators, Temperature Sensors.

· Post-silicon validation and debugging experience on real silicon or evaluation boards.

· Experience with PVT testing, statistical analysis, and corner case validation.

· Proficiency in lab instruments: Oscilloscope, Logic Analyzer, Spectrum Analyzer, Network Analyzer, Signal Generator, Power Supply, DMM.

· Strong automation skills using Python, MATLAB, or equivalent.

· Solid knowledge of SoC/ASIC architecture, clocks, resets, and power domains.

· Hands-on experience with bench-level testing, PCB schematics, and soldering/debugging.

· Exposure to signal processing, RF, or high-speed serial interfaces is a strong advantage.

· Good grasp of semiconductor fundamentals, signal integrity, power analysis, and board-level validation
